subject: Re: Schedule & Q: prompt/output/log deletion - execution and proof
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fabrikatech.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: schedule for deletion of prompts/outputs/logs + confirmation artifacts

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Following our SOC 2 follow-up, Fabrikatech needs Redwood to execute a data removal for a subset of development prompts, generated outputs, and request logs tied to our sandbox project (project id: FBK-4412). We want: a scheduled window, a short checklist of what will be removed vs retained, and a deliverable that proves the sweep completed (timestamped manifest + minimal execution logs).

Questions up front:
- Can you confirm which artifacts you will delete vs archive? Specifically: raw prompt text, model-generated outputs, token-level request logs, and KV-cache snapshots.
- What is the expected downtime or impact on our dedicated test endpoints during the operation?
- Timing: we prefer the sweep to happen this month during a 2-hour maintenance window (US-PST). Please propose a date/time.

We're aiming to produce an internal audit record for our compliance team, so the proof needs to include: a CSV manifest (deleted IDs, timestamps), a signed statement from Redwood, and a link to the execution logfile (redacted where necessary).

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Security Operations
Fabrikatech Inc.

[attachment: scope-mapping-fabrikatech-sandbox.pdf (PDF)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fabrikatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: schedule for deletion of prompts/outputs/logs + confirmation artifacts

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Summary below and a proposed schedule.

What we'll remove (per your scope):
- Prompt texts tied to project tag FBK-4412 (prompt_id namespace) — full deletion from prompt-output store and index.
- Model-generated outputs produced for those prompts (embedding and generation outputs) — deleted from object store and search indexes.
- Request logs: token-level request entries older than 30 days matching the project tag will be purged from active log storage; we will retain a compressed audit chain (hash pointers) for 365 days for legal/audit continuity and will document the retention boundaries.
- KV-cache snapshots: ephemeral caches will be cleared; persistent checkpoints labeled FBK-4412 will be removed if marked as customer-owned snapshots.

What we will not delete: aggregated usage billing records and aggregated per-route metrics (these remain for billing and SLAs).

Proposed window: Tue 2026-10-13 02:00-04:00 PT (low traffic). Estimated customer impact: sub-second transient latency changes during pruning; no downtime to customer endpoints. We will route in-flight requests to a warmed fallback model for any short replays.

Deliverables after execution (what we can provide):
- CSV manifest (deleted_item_id, artifact_type, deletion_timestamp, operator)
- Execution logfile (redacted to remove payloads) — CSV/CSV.gz
- Signed confirmation PDF from Redwood Security Ops
- Drive folder with the above plus the internal deletion checklist

I will coordinate Marissa (Ops) and loop in Sean (Audit) to prepare the manifest and the signed confirmation. If that window works, we'll schedule and provide a final runbook 48 hours prior.

Next steps: please confirm the 10/13 window or suggest an alternate 2-hour slot. Also confirm whether the compressed audit-chain (hash pointer) is acceptable to Fabrikatech for the 365-day retention.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[attachment: redwood-deletion-checklist-v1.2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fabrikatech.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: schedule for deletion of prompts/outputs/logs + confirmation artifacts

Elena — quick operational notes from the execution side:

- We'll run a two-stage sweep: (1) metadata-index prune to remove references; (2) background object deletion for large artifacts. The manifest will include an operation_id for traceability.
- For KV caches: we only delete snapshots that are tagged as customer-owned; ephemeral caches are already rotated but we will enforce an immediate clear for FBK-4412.
- We will take a snapshot of system metrics + request queue lengths 15 minutes pre- and post-sweep to show levels remained within SLOs. Those metric snapshots will be included in the Drive folder.

Operational asks for Fabrikatech before 10/13:
1) Confirm that FBK-4412 is the complete tag set for artifacts to be purged.
2) Provide an authorized approver for the signed statement (name + title + email).

I'll prepare the runbook and the JIRA ticket (SECOPS-4782) and post it to the Drive link below.

Marissa Cole
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Elena / Ben —

Confirming execution completed on Tue 2026-10-13 02:00 PT as scheduled. Deliverables are in the Drive folder linked below and attached:

What we delivered:
- sweep-execution-log-20261002.csv (manifest of deleted IDs; columns: item_id, type, deletion_ts_utc, operator, op_id)
- redwood-deletion-checklist-v1.2.pdf (completed checklist; signed)

Key notes:

- No customer-facing downtime was observed. Latency variance stayed within the declared SLOs (p95 within 5% of baseline).

Drive link (restricted to Fabrikatech and Redwood ops): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_example_deletion_evidence
JIRA: SECOPS-4782 — runbook and post-mortem uploaded.

If you prefer, Sean can produce a short audit memo that summarizes the verification steps and evidence chain.

Thanks for coordinating — let me know if you need any additional artifacts or an executed notarized statement.

Regards,
